description: Jovita Neliupšienė, Ambassador of the European Union to the United States, says Europe supports freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz as higher energy prices pressure European economies. She also discusses freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, EU-U.S. trade, NATO defense commitments and potential measures against Chinese overcapacity. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Tyler Kendall on Bloomberg’s Balance of Power. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: EU Envoy Says Strait of Hormuz Must Remain Open

author: Irina Anghel
description: Confidence among the lowest-earning Britons plunged in May and even those on average pay are digging into savings to meet everyday expenses as the Iran energy shock hits household budgets, a key survey found.
title: Only High-Earning Britons Are Defying the Energy Shock, GfK Says

description: John Bolton, former National Security Advisor in President Trump's first term, says negotiations with Iran will not produce a satisfactory deal and argues the ceasefire has only benefited Tehran. He urges the U.S. to force open the Strait of Hormuz for Arab oil exports while keeping pressure on Iranian shipments, and weighs in on Russia sanctions and regime change in Cuba. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Tyler Kendall on Bloomberg's Balance of Power. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Bolton Calls Iran Talks a 'Waste of Oxygen'

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: A Ukrainian offensive against Russia earlier this year retook about 400 square kilometers after thousands of portable Starlink internet terminals operated by Russian forces were deactivated, according to the US Defense Intelligence Agency.
title: Ukraine Retook Territory After Hobbling Starlink, Pentagon Says

author: Roxana Tiron, Erik Wasson, Steven T. Dennis
description: House Republican leaders abruptly canceled a vote on the Iran war as GOP absences threatened an embarrassing defeat for President Donald Trump.
title: House Leaders Cancel Iran War Vote Amid GOP Absences

author: Manuela Tobias, Jorgelina Do Rosario
description: The International Monetary Fund’s executive board approved Argentina’s latest program review to unlock about $1 billion, a vote of confidence in President Javier Milei despite missing a key program target.
title: IMF Approves About $1 Billion Disbursement for Argentina in Fresh Win for Milei

author: Jorgelina Do Rosario
description: World Bank Group said on Thursday that it remains supportive of Bolivia’s reform agenda, as social protests spread across the country and the government announced a cabinet reshuffle.
title: World Bank Says It Backs Bolivia’s Reform Agenda Amid Protests

author: Misha Savic
description: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic said he plans to call an early election to be held between late September and mid-November as he confronts more than a year of anti-government protests.
title: Serbia’s Vucic Seeks Early Election in Fall in Protest Response

author: Leah Nylen, Josh Sisco
description: Live Nation Entertainment Inc. should be required to divest its Ticketmaster unit to fix its illegal monopolization of the live music industry, state attorneys general told a court Thursday.
title: States Seek Live Nation-Ticketmaster Breakup After Antitrust Win

description: Today, Katy Kaminski, chief research strategist and portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex Group on the bond market as inflation fears and oil prices have sent rates higher. Then, Nancy Tengler. CEO anmd CIO of Laffer Tengler Investments on recent slate of new tech IPOs as SpaceX and OpenAI take the first steps to public trading and fight for future AI market control. Plus, Jennifer Welch, Bloomberg Economic chief geoeconomics analyst, breaks down the latest from the MidEast as Iran seeks to enact a toll on ships going through the Strait of Hormuz. Finally, Gautam Bhandai co-founder, managing partner & global CIO at I Squared talks alternative investments. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: SpaceX, OpenAI Compete For Control in IPO Frenzy | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 5/21/2026

author: Allyson Versprille
description: The US Department of Homeland Security has threatened to curtail customs processing at airports in so-called sanctuary cities in order to bring them in line with the Trump administration’s immigration policies.
title: DHS Renews Threat to Cut Airport Customs in Certain Cities

author: Hugo Miller
description: UBS Group AG accused the US lawyer overseeing a six-year-old inquiry into Credit Suisse’s handling of Nazi-linked accounts of bias and exceeding his mandate, deepening a standoff between the Swiss bank and its critics in Washington.
title: UBS Hits Back Over Nazi-Accounts Probe Amid Senate Pressure

author: Enda Curran, Mark Schroers, Ye Xie, Jorgelina Do Rosario
description: Investors in the safe haven of G7 debt want protection as the conflict in the Middle East threatens another bout of inflation.
title: $50 Trillion Safe-Haven Debt Market Upended by Iran War Inflation

description:
Keir Starmer’s 2024 landslide became a sinkhole in under two years. Bloomberg Originals explains how British politics collided with economic reality, fueling a revolving door of prime ministers.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Why Fixing the UK Is So Hard

author: Jeff Mason
description: US President Donald Trump said he would send an additional 5,000 troops to Poland, reversing course on a plan to suspend an Army deployment to the allied country.
title: Trump to Deploy 5,000 US Troops to Poland, Nixing Planned Cuts

author: Nancy Cook
description: Persistent inflation may make it harder for the central bank to quickly cut rates.
title: Trump Urged by Allies to Give New Fed Chair Warsh Breathing Room

author: Sherif Tarek
description: Iraq formed a high-level committee to investigate drone attacks on the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia, as the new Iraqi prime minister appears to align with US President Donald Trump’s goal of limiting Iran’s influence in the OPEC nation.
title: Iraq Set to Jointly Probe Drone Strikes on UAE and Saudi Arabia

description: Tell Americans long enough that everything is rigged, and they’ll be less likely to engage with the system itself, says Bloomberg Opinion columnist David M. Drucker. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: How Trump's ‘Rigged’ Trend Divided the US

author: Joe Deaux, Kate O'Keeffe
description: The Pentagon is weighing whether to scrap an $80 million conditional loan offer to rare-earths refiner ReElement Technologies Corp., touching off a clash with the White House over an agreement that was meant to help break China’s chokehold on critical minerals.
title: Pentagon Doubts Over Rare Earths Deal Provoke White House Clash

author: Bill Allison
description: President Donald Trump and his Republican allies have amassed a $939 million war chest ahead of November midterms, more than tripling the Democrats’ haul and setting them up to mount a formidable fight in their uphill effort to retain control of Congress.
title: GOP Midterms Cash Nears $1 Billion, More Than Triple Democrats’

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Kailey Leinz and Tyler Kendall discuss the latest from Capitol Hill. On today's show, former Republican Congressman Patrick McHenry, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, ROKK Solutions Partner Kristen Hawn and Republican Senator Shelley Moore Capito. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Fund Faces GOP Backlash | Balance of Power: Early Edition 5/21/2026

author: Omar Tamo, Jeff Mason
description: Iran said the latest proposal from the US partly bridged the gap between the warring sides but comments from the Islamic Republic’s Supreme Leader about keeping Tehran’s uranium stockpile and a dispute over tolls in the Strait of Hormuz clouded the outlook for a breakthrough.
title: Progress in Iran Talks Undercut by Divide Over Uranium, Tolls

description: On today’s Big Take podcast, Stacey Vanek Smith and economist Julianne Malveaux talks about the economic impact of politicians trying to redistrict America ahead of midterms. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: The Economic Impact of Gerrymandering

author: Gerry Doyle
description: Iran has destroyed more than two dozen MQ-9 Reaper drones operated by US forces since the war began, a significant loss worth nearly $1 billion that represents 20% of the Pentagon’s prewar inventory for the hard-to-replace unmanned system.
title: Iran Has Destroyed Roughly $1 Billion Worth of US Reaper Drones

author: Helen Nyambura
description: An India-Africa summit due to begin in New Delhi at the end of May has been postponed indefinitely because of concerns about the Ebola outbreak.
title: India-Africa Summit Postponed Indefinitely Over Ebola Outbreak

description: Iran is discussing with Oman how to set up a permanent toll system to formalize its control of maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. President Donald Trump says he wants the waterway open and free. Bloomberg's Jeff Mason has the latest from the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Looks at Setting Up Permanent Hormuz Toll System

author: Katrina Manson
description: The Pentagon is testing artificial intelligence models to see which are most favored by 25 of the department’s “power users,” as the US military races to find alternatives to Anthropic PBC’s Claude, according to a senior defense official.
title: Pentagon Tests Rival AI Models in Race to Replace Anthropic

author: Erik Wasson, Steven T. Dennis, Caitlin Reilly
description: Senate Republicans stalemated over funding for Donald Trump’s White House ballroom and a $1.8 billion account to pay political allies alleged to be victims of government “weaponization,” a dramatic setback for the president even as he threatens to vanquish perceived political foes within his own party.
title: GOP Stalemates on Trump Ballroom Funding, Weaponization Fund

author: Alex Longley
description: Five Middle Eastern countries have formally rejected Iran’s establishment of the Persian Gulf Strait Authority to control transit through the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Gulf States Tell Ships Not to Use Iran’s Strait of Hormuz Route

description: President Donald Trump says "birthright citizenship is a disgrace," but he expects the US Supreme Court to allow it. Justices are expected to hand down a decision before they leave for the summer. Trump speaks in the Oval Office. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Calls Birthright Citizenship a 'Disgrace'

author: Christopher Charleston
description: The US Army Corps of Engineers finalized an easement for a stretch of the Dakota Access pipeline that passes under a North Dakota lake, ending a years-long environmental review of the hotly contested oil conduit.
title: US Finalizes Easement for Dakota Access Crude Oil Pipeline

author: Lydia Beyoud
description: US Securities and Exchange Commission member Hester Peirce is set to depart the agency and join Regent University School of Law as an associate professor in November, according to a statement from the Virginia school.
title: SEC’s Peirce to Depart Wall Street Regulator for Law School Job

description: President Donald Trump says removing restrictions on gases used in refrigerators and air conditioners will lower costs for businesses, calling the requirements "ridiculous." He spoke to reporters during an event at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Eases Restrictions on Refrigerants for Appliances

author: Rachel Gamarski, Barbara Nascimento, Daniel Carvalho
description: Some Brazilian executives and investors are tempering their support for presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro as he seeks backing in the nation’s financial hub days after details emerged about his relationship with a scandal-plagued banker.
title: Brazilian Executives Waver on Flávio Bolsonaro Over His Ties to Jailed CEO

author: Rachel Schilke, Sarah Babbage
description: The Justice Department told senators that President Donald Trump and his sons won’t financially benefit from a new $1.8 billion fund to address victims of government “weaponization” and assured them the money would carry no partisan restrictions.
title: Trump Won’t Be Paid by ‘Weaponization’ Fund, DOJ Memo Says

description: President Trump says the US wants the Strait of Hormuz to be open and free of tolls. Iran is in talks with Oman to set up some form of a permanent toll system. Trump spoke to reporters at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Wants Strait of Hormuz Open, Free, With No Tolls

description: President Donald Trump delivers remarks from the Oval Office on ballroom construction progress, tariffs, relations with Cuba, and the war in Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Will Get Iran's Uranium

author: Emily Birnbaum
description: DraftKings and FanDuel are on a roll when it comes to backing political campaigns in a state known for being at the center of college sports, marking an early victory for the industry as it seeks to install gambling-friendly lawmakers in state legislatures across the country.
title: DraftKings, FanDuel Amass Pro-Gambling Wins in Alabama Primary

author: Laura Nahmias, Nacha Cattan
description: A proposal to levy a new tax on all-cash real estate transactions over $1 million in New York City is likely to be dropped from the New York state budget, according to people familiar with the negotiations.
title: New York’s Tax on NYC Cash Home Purchases Is Close to Collapse

author: Sybilla Gross, Paula Sambo, Stephen Wicary
description: Facing a crisis after the US expanded sanctions on Cuba, Sherritt International may now be rescued by a former adviser to the president.
title: How Trump’s Cuba Grudge Threw a 99-Year-Old Mining Company Into Turmoil

description: French Budget Minister David Amiel pledged €710 million ($823 million) in new measures to support households and companies hit by rising energy costs due to the Iran war.
title: France Will Add €710 Million in Aid to Offset High Energy Costs

author: Jeff Mason, Oma Seddiq
description: The White House has postponed the signing of an executive order by President Donald Trump that would address cybersecurity concerns raised by powerful new artificial intelligence models, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: White House Postpones AI Cybersecurity Order Signing by Trump

author: Erik Larson
description: The US Justice Department on May 18 struck a deal with President Donald Trump to create a $1.77 billion legal fund to pay victims of alleged government “weaponization,” an unusual agreement that could result in millions of dollars in taxpayer money being doled out to Trump’s allies and supporters.
title: Why Critics Call Trump’s $1.8B Anti-Weaponization Fund an Abuse of Power

author: Ott Tammik
description: The Baltic states have hit back against a Kremlin “disinformation campaign” claiming that they’ve opened their airspace to allow Ukrainian drones to strike Russia.
title: Baltics Rebuke Russia for ‘Disinfo’ on Ukraine Drone Incursions

author: Selcan Hacaoglu, Firat Kozok
description: A Turkish court removed the leader of the country’s main opposition party in a landmark ruling that triggered a stock market selloff and could strengthen President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s grip on power.
title: Turkey Court Unseats Opposition Head, Triggering Market Rout

description: Iran is discussing with Oman how to set up some form of a permanent toll system that will formalize its control of maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Iran in Talks With Oman Over Permanent Toll System for Hormuz

description: The Lithuanian military activated sirens and told residents of the northeastern Utena region to seek shelter after unidentified drones crossed into the Baltic state.

description: In a state known for pro-business policies, some local activists are trying to block the big-money projects that power AI

description: European Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis says the euro area is facing a "stagflationary shock" as real GDP forecasts for 2026 dip, and inflation is seen accelerating beyond the European Central Bank's 2% target. Dombrovskis spoke to Bloomberg's Oliver Crook in Brussels after the European Union's executive arm released its Spring 2026 Economic Forecast. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: EU Forecasts Show Stagflationary Shock, Dombrovskis Says

description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX pulled back the curtain on a business empire that has racked up ballooning losses and debt after acquiring a cash-hungry startup, and pumping billions of dollars into futuristic endeavors ranging from AI to a Mars rocket. Bloomberg's Mandeep Singh joined Tom Keene and Paul Sweeney to discuss saying he doesn't get the SpaceX valuation. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: I Don't Get The Valuation of SpaceX Says Mandeep Singh

description: Russian President Vladimir Putin and his Belarus counterpart, Alexander Lukashenko, took part by videolink in massive joint nuclear drills, the Belarusian Defense Ministry said.
title: Putin and Lukashenko Monitor Major Russia-Belarus Nuclear Drills

description: The Trump administration on Thursday intends to delay compliance with two rules on refrigerants as it looks to dismantle former President Joe Biden’s environmental agenda.

description: Several major issues show the growing unease among Republicans in Congress
title: Key Votes Loom on Iran War, Trump ‘Weaponization’ Fund

description: Australia’s largest privately held weapons maker sees major opportunities in the nation’s military buildup, planning to expand artillery shell production, partner with drone makers and eventually build missile motors.

description: The European Union will propose temporarily lifting sanctions on a Chinese semiconductor supplier after automakers warned of impending supply chain chaos if the ban isn’t removed.
title: EU to Seek Carve-Out for Banned China Chips to Shield Auto Firms

description: Hungary will probably have a very elevated budget shortfall this year, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said, accusing Viktor Orban’s administration of misrepresenting the data.

title: Iran’s Football Team Seeks World Cup Travel Visas for US, Canada

description: A new global satellite system to alert US forces of incoming missile attacks was one of the “lowest performing” Space Force programs last year and risks developing “mission-critical defects” after being launched into orbit, according to an unreleased service report.
title: Space Force Missile Alert Satellites at Risk of Critical Defects

description: Banco Master’s collapse has spotlighted its disgraced former chief’s ties to Brazil’s political elite.
title: Another Brazil Election Is Upended by Graft

description: Iran is assessing the latest peace proposal from the US, as the countries seek to avoid a resumption of hostilities. The exchange of messages is based on Iran’s 14-point text from several weeks ago, Foreign Ministry Spokesman Esmail Baghaei said. Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

description: The euro area will slow markedly while suffering the fastest inflation since 2023 as it succumbs to the energy-cost surge from the Iran war, according to the European Commission.

description: Iran is assessing the latest peace proposal from the US, as the countries seek to avoid a resumption of hostilities.

title: Austrian Spy Found Guilty of Giving Secrets to Wirecard Fugitive

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

On today's show, stocks in Asia jumped as investors returned to the AI trade. Shares in the world's most valuable company slipped after Nvidia's sales forecast failed to meet the loftiest expectations. CEO Jensen Huang touted progress in diversifying the chipmaker, saying so-called physical AI will bring a colossal new opportunity.

After months of speculation, SpaceX has filed publicly for what would be the biggest-ever IPO. The documents reveal a net loss of $4.28 billion on revenue of $4.69 billion for the first quarter. There's also a super-voting share plan that would allow Elon Musk to keep the company under his control. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Nvidia Disappoints & SpaceX Files for Record IPO | Daybreak Europe 05/21/2026

description: UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Rachel Reeves is set to announce a package of measures, dubbed "Great British Summer Savings," in an effort to ease cost-of-living pressures made worse by the Iran war. Bloomberg's James Woolcock reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: UK's Reeves Set to Unveil 'Great British Summer Savings'

author: Sanne Wass
description: The US is facing protests in Greenland’s capital as a new consulate opening fuels concerns over Washington’s designs for the island.
title: US Opens Greenland Consulate as Unease Grows Over Trump Push

description: President Donald Trump said the US was in the "final stages" with Iran, but also threatened to resume attacks in the coming days if the Islamic Republic didn’t agree to his terms. Meanwhile, President Masoud Pezeshkian insisted the country was not on the brink of giving in. Bloomberg's Paul Wallace reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Is in 'Final Stages' With Iran

description: The UK signed a long-awaited trade deal with the Gulf Cooperation Council on Thursday, deepening its ties with the oil-rich nations at a time of rising geopolitical tension and economic pressures.
title: UK and Gulf States Hail Trade Deal After Four Years of Talks

description: Oil market participants are increasingly pricing crude to be capped near $100 a barrel over the next year, as demand is forced to slow down to counter millions of barrels of supply losses caused by the US-Iran war.
title: Oil Near $100 Emerges as Consensus for Next Year With Iran War

author: Manolo Serapio Jr
description: The Philippines’ Department of Justice has ordered the arrest of Senator Ronald Dela Rosa, the missing lawmaker being sought by the International Criminal Court over allegations of crimes against humanity.
title: Philippines’ Justice Department Orders Arrest of ICC-Wanted Senator

description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Chief Executive Jamie Dimon criticized plans by New York’s left-leaning mayor Zohran Mamdani to slap more taxes on the rich, arguing the move risks doing further damage to the city’s status as a business hub.
title: Mamdani’s Tax Plans Risk Hurting New York, Says JPMorgan’s Dimon

description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is pushing the European Union to consider associate membership for Ukraine as Berlin tries to inject life into the bloc’s enlargement process.
title: German Government Pushes Associate EU Membership for Ukraine

author: Alex Wickham, Ellen Milligan
description: In the midst of two major wars, the UK’s Foreign Office is undertaking job cuts so severe that it’s about to halve the size of its team dealing with the fallout from the conflict with Iran.
title: UK’s Iran Crisis Team Slashed as Part of Foreign Office Job Cuts

description: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendira Debyavati’s condition has deteriorated, indicating a “severe and uncontrolled infection affecting multiple vital organs,” according to a statement from the Bureau of the Royal Household.
title: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha’s Condition Worsens, Palace Says

description: President Lee Jae Myung came to power promising stronger labor protection and social cohesion, while vowing to transform South Korea into an AI powerhouse competing with the US and China. Now, those ambitions are starting to collide.
title: Samsung AI Bonus Spat Tests South Korea’s Labor-Friendly Leader

description: Chinese President Xi Jinping may visit North Korea as early as next week, Yonhap News reported citing government officials, as Beijing and Pyongyang move to strengthen longstanding ties.
title: Xi May Visit North Korea as Early as Next Week, Yonhap Says

description: President Donald Trump is poised to issue an executive order as soon as Thursday aimed at bolstering artificial intelligence cybersecurity and has asked tech industry leaders to join for the event, according to people familiar with the matter.
